Definition: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
BiblicalUsage: 1) rock, cliff; 1a) rocky wall, cliff; 1b) rock (with flat surface); 1c) block of stone, boulder; 1d) rock (specific); 1e) rock (of God); 1f) rock (of heathen gods) n pr dei; 1g) Rock
